cobbletank.option.tank_breaks_glass.tool: A bursting Cobble Tank breaks glass out to about 55 blocks from a full tank, and blows wooden doors, trapdoors and gates open out to about 28. Set on the server.
cobbletank.option.tank_litres.tooltip: Gas volume of a newly placed Cobble Tank. Tanks already placed keep theirs. Set on the server.
cobbletank.option.tank_psi.tooltip: Starting pressure of a newly placed Cobble Tank. More pressure means a stronger jet and a bigger burst. Set on the server.
cobbletank.option.fragment_rays.tooltip: How many casing fragments the server traces when a tank bursts. More can hit more targets, so this changes gameplay, not just looks. Solid blocks stop each one. Set on the server.
cobbletank.option.tank_fragment_range.to: How far tank fragments can fly, in blocks. Remaining pressure, solid cover and unloaded chunks can stop them sooner. Set on the server.
cobbletank.option.tank_wave_percent.tool: How much of the stored gas energy goes into the blast wave when a tank bursts. A gameplay choice: higher is more destructive. Set on the server; tanks keep the value they were placed with.
cobbletank.tank.status: %s psi | shell %s C | cut %s%% | heat damage %s%%. Sneak-use a stick to open the valve.
cobbletank.option.tank_fire_seconds.tool: How quickly fire heats a tank and weakens its shell. Pressure, leaks and earlier damage decide when it bursts. Set on the server.
